summary: This clipped note is a navigation-heavy capture of the Victorian government energy website page titled 'Top 10 energy saving tips' under Households > Save energy and money. The actual tip text is not included; the captured content consists only of menu links and page-section labels. The menus show that the page has sub-pages for winter and summer energy saving tips, and sits alongside related household tools and programs such as Compare energy offers, the Residential Efficiency Scorecard, Smart meters and the $250 Power Saving Bonus.
one_line: Menu capture of the Victorian energy website's 'Top 10 energy saving tips' page, with links to winter and summer tips and related household programs.
key_facts: The captured page is titled 'Top 10 energy saving tips' and is hosted on energy.vic.gov.au, the Victorian government energy website.
The 'Top 10 energy saving tips' page sits under the Households section, within the 'Save energy and money' menu group.
The 'Top 10 energy saving tips' page has two listed sub-pages: 'Winter energy saving tips' and 'Summer energy saving tips'.
The 'Save energy and money' menu also lists 'Compare energy offers', 'Residential Efficiency Scorecard' and 'Smart meters' as sub-pages.
The Households menu lists the '$250 Power Saving Bonus' and the 'Solar Homes Program' as household offerings.
The Households menu lists '7 star energy efficiency building standards' with a sub-page on common questions.
The Households menu lists 'Help paying your bills', with sub-pages 'Energy Assistance Program', 'Understanding your energy bill' and 'Your energy rights'.

The Households menu lists 'Victorian Energy Upgrades for households', with sub-pages covering the VEU program, clothes dryers, fridges and freezers, heating and cooling, hot water systems and induction cooktops.
The Households menu's Victorian Energy Upgrades section also lists insulation, lighting, pool pumps, shower heads, televisions, weather sealing and window glazing.
The site has separate top-level sections for Businesses, Industry, Renewable energy, Grants, Safety and About energy.
The note contains no body text giving the content of the ten energy saving tips themselves.
